听：He was wrongly accused of stealing.
A. 真的偷了
B. 被表扬
C. 被冤枉偷东西
D. 丢了东西

【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：The letter was ______ sent to my neighbour.
A. wrong

题目.题目5:

题目.题目6:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：Which word means about the same as "wrongly"?
A. mistakenly
B. rightly
C. luckily
D. quickly
考点：易混
题目.题目7:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干："He was wrongly punished" means he ______.
A. did something bad
B. was not punished
C. punished others
D. was punished but did nothing wrong
考点：用法
题目.答案:
【1】C（被冤枉偷东西）
讲解：wrongly accused 被冤枉。
【2】C（wrongly）
讲解：放在过去分词 sent 前用 wrongly。
【3】wrong
讲解：修饰名词 number 用形容词 wrong。
【4】wrong
讲解：What's wrong with … 怎么了。
【5】wrong → wrongly
讲解：放在过去分词 told 前用 wrongly。
【6】A（mistakenly）
讲解：wrongly = mistakenly 错误地。
【7】D（was punished but did nothing wrong）
讲解：wrongly 也有“冤枉地”的意思。
